reasons.claim: The chain runs from Abu Dawud to Hurayth b. Qabisa through single links.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا أبو داود، قال حدثنا هارون

reasons.claim: Hurayth tells of sitting with Abu Hurayra, who speaks the saying in the story, so Abu Hurayra is the last link (ruling 9).
The gloss on Harun and Hammam's doubt and the closing remark add no links.
The report only cites another wording and names no transmitter.
The chain is al-Bazanti, al-Muthanna, Zurara, then the Imam.
reasons.quote: رَوَى الْبَزَنْطِيُّ عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The first-person question is Zurara's to the Imam, who answers; it adds no further link.
The chain ends at Ibn Umar; the dream of the Prophet is the subject, not a link, and Abu Bakr and Umar are named in the subject.
reasons.quote: عن عبد الله بن عمر، عن رؤيا النبي

reasons.claim: The chapter remark is not a route.
The text is a saying only with no transmitter.
Three transmitters are linked by «عن» down to Ishaq b. Ghalib.
reasons.quote: النضر عن إبراهيم بن عبد الحميد عن إسحاق بن غالب

reasons.claim: The Imam whose words are heard is the last link.
reasons.quote: سمعت أبا عبد الله عليه السلام يقول

reasons.claim: The first saying's chain runs Sulayman b. Harb, Hammad b. Zayd, Thabit, Anas.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سليمان بن حرب، حدثنا حماد بن زيد، عن ثابت، عن أنس

reasons.claim: A second saying about Abu Talib follows with its own isnad, so under ruling 10 it is stored as its own route; the readers left it out.
reasons.quote: وقال سعيد بن المسيب عن أبيه، لما حضر أبو طالب

groups.saying_opens: أن غلاما، ليهود كان يخدم النبي
لما حضر أبو طالب جاءه النبي

notes: second saying with its own suspended isnad stored as its own route (ruling 10)

reviews.uncertainty_note: The suspended second isnad could be taken as a chapter remark rather than a second saying.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters stand at one level before the Imam.
reasons.quote: رَوَى أَبُو اَلْعَبَّاسِ وَ عُبَيْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The chain runs Muhammad b. al-Muthanna, Khalid, Humayd.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، عن خالد، قال حدثنا حميد

reasons.claim: Anas is asked and answers relaying the Prophet, so he is the last link; the gloss adds nothing.
reasons.quote: قال سئل أنس - وهو ابن مالك -
